rungs.can: add and remove items, and toggle flag bits, for every item at once
rungs.operator: XOR flip masks, the arrangement swap
rungs.checked: by the rung 1 tests (each of 15 masks, twice is the identity)

rungs.can: read every item and every flag word exactly, and count items near a query
rungs.checked: keys exact 30/30 at 16 keys, refused 30/30 at 17 and beyond

rungs.can: bind two stores so all pairs combine in one pass (keys add, flags XOR, arrangements compose)
rungs.checked: equal to the store of all pairs, 35/35 across five shapes

rungs.can: apply weighted shifts and relabellings, and count any Boolean predicate of flag words in one read
rungs.superposed: the store as a lookup table
rungs.operator: kernel elements; the Walsh spectrum of a predicate

rungs.can: permute or gather all keys, conjugate arrangements, square flag words in GF(2)
rungs.operator: `ScaleKeys`, conjugation, `Frobenius` (harmonic permutations, one pass per term in a mix)
rungs.checked: all 120 units of 225 permute; Frobenius has order exactly 8 on GF(2^8)

rungs.can: join two coprime key cycles into one key space, test whether joint counts are independent, read Hamming syndromes
rungs.checked: CRT pairs 12/12; all 112 single errors of Hamming(7,4) located

rungs.can: age every item, diffuse every item over time, step flag words through a shift register
rungs.checked: 600/600 diffusion steps exact; register periods 255 and 63

rungs.can: read the winding, frustration parity and circulation direction of loops of relations stored in the same object
rungs.operator: loops read as linear functionals; rates as exponents over primes
rungs.checked: holonomy, parity and current (2,176/2,176 loop reads; 200/200 current signs); locating a contradiction is not shipped

rungs.can: draw one value with probability count / total
rungs.operator: none: a read-time choice, which is not superposable
rungs.checked: every draw lands on its value
